## Project Overview
Coralys Decision UI — a read-only analyst workstation for reviewing trade decisions from the ChronoSentiment system. Built as a Next.js 15 app (App Router) with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui components. Data loaded from `/public/data/*.json` — no API calls.

## Completed Work
- **MVP-001 through MVP-010**: All complete and frozen
- **HDV-001-A**: Period definitions frozen — docs/HDV_001_PERIODS.md (commit 588e1fe7f)
- **HDV-001-B**: Price cache certified — 52 instruments, 5/5 integrity checks PASS (commit 588e1fe7f)
- **HDV-001-C**: Price path extractor — 1144/1144, 728 COMPLETE, 416 MATURING, 0 NO_CACHE (commit 588e1fe7f)
- **HDV-001-D**: MAE/MFE calculator — hdv001_decision_metrics_v1.json (1144 records) (commit f6a321976)
- **HDV-001-E**: Outcome classifier — hdv001_outcomes_v1.json (1144 records) (commit f6a321976)
- **HDV-001-G**: Freeze gate — all 6 gates PASS, development evidence frozen 2026-08-17 (commit c8bdec3fb)
- **HDV-001-F (invalid v1)**: Documented as invalid; retained as audit artifact (commit 2dc196def)
- **HDV-001-F (corrected v2)**: Baselines corrected (commit 2dc196def)
- **HDV-001-F Official Criterion Evaluation**: PASS — Gate1 +6.0pp, Gate2 +12.4pp, Gate3 2/4 segments (commit a7919ce06)
- **HDV-002-A**: Methodology freeze gate — docs/HDV_002_METHODOLOGY.md (commit 901ee439c)
- **HDV-001 Results Dashboard**: hdv001-dashboard/ — Vite/React, read-only, port 5174 (commits a26bc12ec + b3e6b4c9a)

## Key Technical Decisions
- All UI data loaded from `/public/data/*.json` — no API calls, no server components fetching data
- Dark theme, monospace accents, minimal chrome, data-dense design
- Color coding: green for wins, red for losses, amber for open/maturing
- Components in `/components/`, shared types in `/lib/types.ts`, utilities in `/lib/utils.ts`
- `chrono-ui/AGENTS.md` contains Next.js agent rules: read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before writing any code; APIs/conventions may differ from training data
- `chrono-ui/` connects to Coralys Decision Server at `CORALYS_API_URL` (default `http://localhost:3001`), gracefully returns empty state when server isn't running

## Relevant Files & Code
- `chrono-ui/CLAUDE.md` — references `@AGENTS.md` (single line)
- `chrono-ui/AGENTS.md` — Next.js agent rules (read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before coding)
- `coralys-decision-ui/` — separate project directory (index.html, package.json, tsconfig.json visible)
- `hdv001-dashboard/` — Vite/React dashboard, port 5174
- `datasets/hdv001/HDV_001_F_DETERMINATION.md` — determination document for HDV-001-F
- `chrono-ui/app/decisions/page.tsx` — Decision Feed page (Screen 1), async server component, uses `fetchDecisionFeed()` from `@/lib/coralys`
- `chrono-ui/app/decisions/[id]/page.tsx` — Decision Inspector (full record detail)
- `chrono-ui/app/history/page.tsx` — Decision Ledger / history
- `chrono-ui/app/live/page.tsx` — Live outcome tracking
- `chrono-ui/app/portfolio/page.tsx` — Portfolio view
- `chrono-ui/app/audit/page.tsx` — Audit trail
- `chrono-ui/app/provenance/page.tsx` — Provenance
- `chrono-ui/app/replay/page.tsx` — Replay

### Key code pattern (decisions/page.tsx):
```tsx
// Server component — fetches data server-side
export default async function DecisionFeedPage() {
  const feed = await fetchDecisionFeed();
  // feed.total, feed.decisions (FeedEntry[])
}

// FeedEntry fields used: decision_id, instrument, decision_timestamp,
// direction, target_price, reference_risk_boundary_price,
// outcome_status, execution_status
```

## Current Status
`chrono-ui/` Next.js dev server started (`npm run dev`) — running in terminal. The app has 8 routes: /decisions, /decisions/[id], /history, /live, /portfolio, /audit, /provenance, /replay. All connect to Coralys Decision Server at CORALYS_API_URL (default http://localhost:3001) with graceful empty-state fallback. Awaiting further instructions.
